units: <cite ref="Yoma 85a:11">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite> <he>עיקר ח׳ וכ׳</he> the real life is in the nose (cessation of breath from the nostrils is the main sign of death); <cite ref="Sotah 45b:17">Sot. 45ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 19b:11">Ḥull. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כי נפקא ח׳</he> when life escapes.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21b:4">B. Bath. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>פסקת לה לחַיּוּתָאִי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חַיּוּתִי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) thou disturbest my livelihood.

<cite ref="Makkot 10a:9">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>עבד ליה ח׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עביד … מידי דתיהוי ליה ח׳</he>) make life for him so that he may live (give him security of life); <cite ref="Makkot 10a:9">ib.</cite> <he>עביד ליה מידי דתיהוי ליה ח׳</he> prepare for him something which secures life (religious study); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 829:1">Yalk. Deut. 829</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 921:2">921</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 12a:11">Gitt. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>עביד ליה ח׳ טפי</he> you must allow him a more ample living (than under ordinary conditions).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 89a:23">Pes. 89ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>מהיות</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 12:4">Ex. XII, 4</cite>) <he>מחַיּוּתֵיה דשה</he> from the lamb while it is yet alive (you may withdraw).

<cite ref="Exodus 12:4">Ib.</cite> <he>וד״ש סבר מחַיּוֹתָיו דשה</he> Ms. M. 2 (Ar. <he>מחיותיה</he>, ed. <he>מהֲוַיָּיתֵיה</he>) R. S. says, from the life of the lamb in both senses (during life proper and as long as the blood has not yet been sprinkled; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70).
